sources.title: meta-llama/Llama-2-13b-chat · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Developers Meta Variations Llama 2 comes in a range of parameter sizes — 7B, 13B, and 70B — as well as pretrained and fine-tuned variations. Input Models input text only. Output Models generate text only. Model Architecture Llama 2 is an auto-regressive language model that uses an optimized transformer architecture.

sources.snippet: Llama 2 is a collection of foundation language models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters.

sources.title: GitHub - DeltaVML/llama2: Inference code for LLaMA models
sources.snippet: This release includes model weights and starting code for pretrained and fine-tuned Llama language models — ranging from 7B to 70B parameters. This repository is intended as a minimal example to load Llama 2 models and run inference.
